option_relations.rationale: Acute immune thrombocytopenia (ITP) is a general diagnosis of ITP without specifying an underlying cause, which is not directly related to the provided leaf.
Hepatitis C-associated immune thrombocytopenia is a specific type of ITP linked to Hepatitis C, which is not directly related to the provided leaf.
Drug-Induced Thrombocytopenia is a specific cause of low platelets, which is not directly related to the provided leaf.
Hepatitis C-related thrombocytopenia is a general term for low platelets due to Hepatitis C, which is not directly related to the provided leaf.
